latest_release.name: v0.28.10
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Migrate kind e2e tests from bash_unit to Ginkgo by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2513
* build(deps): bump actions/attest-build-provenance from 4.1.1 to 4.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2533
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.37.3 to 4.37.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2532
* Migrate remaining bash_unit tests to Ginkgo / Go by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2534
* build(deps): bump k8s dependencies to v0.34.10 by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2535
* e2e: add dual-stack (IPv4+IPv6) backend test matrix by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2536
* e2e: add flannel resilience/recovery tests by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2538
* e2e: add Service and CoreDNS connectivity test by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2537
* e2e: remove duplicate deletePod helper by @phinze in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2544
* subnet/etcd: unify the two subnet watch loops by @phinze in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2539
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-buildx-action from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2548
* build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.82.1 to 1.83.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2555
* Bump default CNI config cniVersion to 1.0.0 by @tsorya in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2526
* build(deps): upgrade github.com/avast/retry-go to v5 by @chimanjain in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2528
* build(deps): bump the tencent group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2529
* build(deps): bump docker/setup-qemu-action from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2558
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.37.6 to 4.37.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2552
* build(deps): bump actions/deploy-pages from 5.0.0 to 5.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2559
* docs: prefer release kube-flannel.yml over master copy by @locker95 in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2527
* build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.1 to 1.83.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2562
* Bump Go to 1.26 by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2563
* vxlan: recover from closed netlink subscription by @dlanov in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2560
* build(deps): bump the etcd group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2487
* build(deps): bump the other-go-modules group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2561
* build(deps): bump go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc from 1.43.0 to 1.45.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2567
* Bump github/codeql-action from v4.37.3 to v4.38.0 by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2570
* build(deps): bump the etcd group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2578
* build(deps): bump the tencent group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2571
* build(deps): bump the other-go-modules group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2572
* Make sure GHA bumps are grouped by dependabot by @thomasferrandiz in https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pull/2579
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4bd7200e1f146b1c937cae12d258b50f41a53cf8 to
